abstract: A surgical case of teratoma with malignant transformation (TMT) of the mediastinum in a 66-year-old man is reported. The unilocular, cystic, mediastinal mass, which had been seen in a chest radiograph 7 years earlier, was extirpated. The mass was histologically revealed to be a mature cystic teratoma containing skin and respiratory epithelial tissues, with some areas of well-differentiated adenocarcinoma. Surgical cases of TMT in the mediastinum, which have not received any preoperative chemotherapy or radiation therapy, are rare. By reviewing the previous literature on TMT in various organs, the authors distinguished two types of TMT, chemotherapy- or radiotherapy-induced TMT and naturally occurring TMT. The pathogenesis of these two types are discussed.
abstract_ja: 悪性転化を伴う縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の高分化型腺癌の外科的症例を報告する。症例は66歳男性で、7年前の胸部X線で認められた単房性の嚢胞性縦隔腫瘤を摘出した。組織学的には、皮膚および呼吸上皮組織を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、一部に高分化型腺癌の領域を認めた。術前に化学療法も放射線療法も受けていない縦隔の悪性転化例は稀である。各種臓器における悪性転化の文献を検討し、化学療法または放射線療法に誘発されたものと、自然発生的なものの2型に分類した。両者の発生機序について考察する。
